title: From office to farm
text:
Three years ago, Agnieszka Malinowska left her job in a bank in Warsaw and moved to a small farm in the mountains. Now she makes cheese and runs workshops for visitors. We asked her about her new life.

Why did you decide to change your life so completely?
I was working twelve hours a day and I felt exhausted all the time. One weekend I visited a friend's farm and helped her make cheese. I felt calm for the first time in years. On the train back to Warsaw, I started making plans.

Was it difficult at the beginning?
Very! I knew nothing about animals. In the first winter, the water pipes froze and two of my goats got ill. I almost gave up. But my neighbours helped me a lot – they taught me everything from milking to fixing fences.

What does a typical day look like?
I get up at five and milk the goats. Then I work in the cheese room until lunch. In the afternoon I do paperwork or prepare for workshops. In summer, groups come almost every weekend to learn how to make cheese.

Do you earn as much as before?
No, not even half. But I spend much less, too. I don't need expensive clothes or taxis, and I grow most of my vegetables.

Do you ever miss the city?
Sometimes I miss the cinemas and my friends. But I don't miss the traffic or the stress. When I look out of my window in the morning and see the mountains, I know I made the right decision.

What advice would you give to people who dream of a similar change?
Don't do it in a hurry. Try it first – spend a few weeks on a farm. And save some money before you start!
